definitions: The light emitted by a lamp.

blocks.text: "Lamplight" is a song by the Bee Gees, released as the B-side of "First of May", but featured as the single's A-side in Germany. It also featured on their double album Odessa in March 1969. The song was written and composed by Barry, Robin & Maurice Gibb and featured lead vocals by Robin Gibb. No other singles were released from the album, and the fact that the group's manager Robert Stigwood chose "First of May", which only featured Barry Gibb's voice for the A-side, caused Robin to quit the group.
"Lamplight" is a 1980 poem by Australian author Gwen Harwood. It is also known by the title "Mother Who Gave Me Life".
